quote: We present CONDAQA, a QA dataset that contains 14,182 examples to evaluate models' ability to reason about the implication of negated statements.
Accuracy The percentage of predictions which match the ground truth answer. ... Group Consistency CONDAQA's dense annotations enable us to study model robustness through group consistency.
We use two classes of metrics: Accuracy ... and Group Consistency ...
We use the Crowdaq platform to recruit a small pool of qualified workers to contribute to CON-DAQA.
guideline: Workers were asked to read the instructions, and optionally to also go through the tutorial. Workers then took a qualification exam which consisted of 12 multiple-choice questions that evaluated comprehension of the instructions.
